classification: Read-only review under review_rubric.json; original model products remain unchanged
blinding_limit: Organization labels are absent from the exported report filename, but the implementer knows this is the development pilot. No independent blind paired comparison occurred.
schema_and_selected_numeric_values: Accepted initial-report selectors matched exact immutable values. No incorrect accepted numeric selector was found. This does not certify surrounding prose.

findings.claim: The request treats full q/qdot history outside the displayed final window as not retained. The initial report says only the final window is sampled and recommends instrumentation of the full trajectory.
findings.assessment: The full sampled backend trajectory is retained. The current motion query displays the final settling window and lacks an arbitrary full-trajectory velocity query; that is a query/capability gap, not absent recording. Additional instrumentation is not justified merely by this display limit.
findings.consequence: The proposed next work could duplicate existing data collection instead of exposing retained data.

findings.claim: The report describes deadline-induced solver termination and stale/fallback plans as possible mechanisms.

evidence.scheduling: Controller calls complete synchronously before fixed-count backend steps. Deadline misses do not inject physical delay.

findings.assessment: The report correctly retains possible rather than proven status and acknowledges no physical delay, but deadline misses plus User_Requested_Stop do not establish that the 10 ms deadline caused solver termination or stale inputs. Retained policy-stop reasons distinguish budget returns and relative improvement. Small raw weight values also do not by themselves establish negligible normalized cost contributions.
findings.consequence: These mechanisms remain hypotheses requiring discriminating evidence, not established explanations.

check_usefulness: Not evaluated: all three check requests failed before execution. No result exists to support, weaken, or resolve the scientific hypotheses.
minimal_native_validation: Succeeded as a cross-run protocol unit. The model independently chose reject + finish and corrected historical claims of missing predictions/tensions/limits in its reasoning. This is not a completed diagnostic feedback cycle.
comparative_claim: None; no formal paired run or live single-context diagnosis was executed.
